data.one_liner: A Dart extension for the image package to compress and resize images.
data.what_it_does: Provides sync and async compression methods for images using an ImageFile configuration. Allows resizing and reducing image file sizes in pure Dart.
use_when: You need to compress and resize images in Dart
You want a sync or queued async image compression solution
avoid_when: You want to build for Flutter using native compression and WEBP format conversion (use image_compression_flutter instead)
strengths: Supports both synchronous and queued asynchronous compression
Works across multiple platforms including Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux
weaknesses: Native compression and WEBP format conversion are not supported for Android and iOS in this package

alternatives.name: flutter_image_compress
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides native image compression optimized for Flutter applications on Android and iOS.
